name: Flexible Editor Panel for Bricks Builder
author: Rony Bormon

sections.description:
Flexible Editor Panel for Bricks Builder transforms the default Bricks Builder interface by introducing a powerful, flexible panel system.

This plugin allows you to convert the Structure and Elements panels into floating panels that can be freely moved and resized. It provides a more modern and efficient workflow, especially for advanced users and developers.

Features

  • Floating Panels – Convert Structure & Elements panels into free-floating overlays
  • Drag Anywhere – Move panels freely across the entire editor canvas
  • 4-Direction Resize – Resize panels from corner.
  • Minimize Panels – Collapse panels instantly using the close button
  • Flex Mode Toggle – One-click activation via the ⚡ Flex Mode button
  • Keyboard Shortcut – Toggle instantly with Ctrl + Shift + F
  • Zero Frontend Impact – Works exclusively inside the Bricks Builder editor
  • Clean & Lightweight – No bloat, no external dependencies

Links

  • Author: Rony Bormon
  • Website: https://ronybormon.com/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the flexible-bricks-panel folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open the Bricks Builder editor on any page or post.
  4. Click the ⚡ Flex Mode button in the editor toolbar to enable floating panels.
  5. Alternatively, use the keyboard shortcut Ctrl + Shift + F to toggle Flex Mode at any time.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with all Bricks Builder versions?

It is tested with the latest version of Bricks Builder. Compatibility with older versions may vary.

Which panels are supported?

Currently supports:
* Structure Panel
* Elements Panel

Does it affect frontend performance?

No. This plugin only works inside the Bricks Builder editor.

Is the keyboard shortcut customizable?

The default shortcut is Ctrl + Shift + F. Custom shortcut support may be introduced in a future update.
